items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018

ctx.x: I thought that was my rationale for not including them because they were fairly apparent you know and I think that a lot of records where they did that was because when the backing track would overpower the vocals anyway so you needed subtitles.

Yeah. But I didn’t initially think it was necessary. Now I sort of like it. But I think maybe it’s cause at that time the main thing is the, what do you call it, the vinyl. Vinyl is the main product for them and the CDs are a kind of incidental market for them, and you didn’t tend to get lyrics in with the LPs whereas you get a booklet with the — you tend to get a booklet with the CD.
